**Sundhedsklyngen SUH** refers to the health cluster associated with Sjællands Universitetshospital (Zealand University Hospital). It is one of the local healthcare clusters in Denmark whose clinical performance is systematically monitored and reported in the national "Atrieflimren i Danmark" (Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark) quality reports. The cluster's data is used to benchmark the diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of patients with [[atrieflimren]] against national clinical standards.

In terms of clinical quality, Sundhedsklyngen SUH has demonstrated compliance with key treatment standards. For example, it successfully met the target for Indikator 1 (which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy for newly diagnosed patients), achieving a result of 91.5% [^src1]. The cluster is also included in national geographic mappings that track the incidence of ischemic stroke (apopleksi) among atrial fibrillation patients across different health clusters [^src4]. 

However, the cluster's performance varies across different quality metrics. In the 2023/24 reporting period, Sundhedsklyngen SUH recorded the lowest proportion among all evaluated clusters for [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]], which measures the implementation of structured patient education for newly diagnosed individuals, reaching only 0.1% (95% CI: 0.0–0.5) [^src9]. Additionally, the cluster is tracked for other critical outcomes, including severe bleeding incidents, heart failure development, and mortality rates, allowing for regional and national comparisons of cardiovascular care quality [^src6] [^src7]. 

*(Note: While tabular data in the 2024 report places the cluster's metrics adjacent to or within summaries associated with [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] [^src5], Sjællands Universitetshospital is administratively part of Region Sjælland. The cluster remains a distinct unit of analysis in the national quality development program.)*
